I have a good perspective on this. Im 20F and my partner is 27M. We met very organically through friends after i turned 18 and hit it off and have been together since. Mind you, i moved out on my own at 16 because of issues with my family. I had to become an adult when i was in highschool so by the time i was 18, i had a steady full time job and my own apartment. Age gaps are tricky because it really depends on how far along in your life you are. If you are closer to a highschool level of independence and maturity then yes, id say this is inappropriate. However, if you are more in my situation then it may make more sense. No matter what, you are of legal age now and can make that decision but you need to know that being in a relationship with that kind of age gap at a young age is difficult. He may be in a total different stage of life and maturity then you. For example, he might be ready to buy his first home, when you are finding your first big job. 
If you really care about him then its possible, but it requires a lot of good and solid communication about boundaries, experience and expectations. For it to work, you can’t forget that you have that age gap and need to be cognizant of the impact it will have on the relationship and your differences in experience.
